shortDescription: Run the AIX errpt command to report logged system errors.

options.name: ascii_format
options.description: Displays the ASCII representation of unformatted error-log entries..

options.name: concatenated_output
options.description: Controls whether the output of the vmstat command is appended to the output file or is overwrited. If set to true, output will be appended to the file. If set to false, the file will be overwritten with fresh output.

options.name: consolidate_duplicates
options.description: Consolidate duplicate errors .The detailed error report, obtained with the -a flag, reports the number, and first and last times of the duplicates

options.name: detailed
options.description: Displays information about errors in the error log file in detailed format .

options.name: diag_log
options.description: Use specified diagnostic log file. If this flag is not specified, the default pathname, /var/adm/ras/diag_log, is used.

options.name: end_date
options.description: Specifies all records posted prior to and including the EndDate variable, where the EndDate variable has the form mmddhhmmyy.

options.name: error_class
options.description: Limits the error report to certain types of error records specified by the valid ErrorClassList variable . The error records in the ErrorClassList variable can be separated by a , (comma), or enclosed in " " (double quotation marks) And separated by a , (comma), or a space character. C(H) hardware C(S) software C(O) errlogger command messages C(U) undetermined

options.name: error_types
options.description: Limits the error report to error types specified by the valid error_types variables. The error types can be each separated by a , (comma), or enclosed in " " (double quotation marks) and separated by a , or a space character C(INFO) Information C(PEND) Pending C(PERF) Performance related entries C(PERM) Permanent C(TEMP) Temporary C(UNKN) Unknown

options.name: exclude_errids
options.description: Excludes the error-log entries specified by the ErrorID. The ErrorLabel variable values can be separated by commas or enclosed in double-quotation marks and separated by commas or blanks

options.name: exclude_labels
options.description: Excludes the error log entries specified by the ErrorLabel. The ErrorLabel variable values can be separated by commas or enclosed in double-quotation marks and separated by commas or blanks

options.name: include_errids
options.description: Includes only the error-log entries specified by the ErrorID. The ErrorID variables can be separated by a , (comma), or enclosed in " " (double quotation marks) and separated by a , (comma), or a space character

options.name: include_labels
options.description: Includes the error log entries specified by the ErrorLabel. The ErrorLabel variable values can be separated by commas or enclosed in double-quotation marks and separated by commas or blanks

options.name: input_log
options.description: Use specified error log file. If this flag is not specified, the value from the error log configuration database is used

options.name: machine
options.description: Includes error-log entries for the specified Machine variable .

options.name: node
options.description: Includes error-log entries for the specified Node variable .

options.name: recorded_output
options.description: Folder path to command output in machine.

options.name: resource_names
options.description: Generates a report of resource names specified by the resource_names. The resource_names is a list of names of resources that have detected errors. The resource_names variable can be separated by a , (comma), or enclosed in " " (double quotation marks) And separated by a , (comma), or a space character.

options.name: sequence_number
options.description: Selects a unique error-log entry specified by the sequence_number variable. The sequence_number variable can be separated by a , (comma), or enclosed in " " (double quotation marks) And separated by a , (comma), or a space character.

options.name: short_detail
options.description: Show shortened version of detailed error .

options.name: start_date
options.description: Specifies all records posted on and after the StartDate, where the StartDate variable has the format mmddhhmmyy.
